question: Find the compound interest on Rs.1,000 at 20% per annum for one year if interest is compounded half-yearly.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal = Rs.1,000

Rate = 20% per annum

Time = 1 year

Compounded half-yearly

**Concept:**

Compound Interest formula when compounded half-yearly,

A = P(1 + r/2n)⁽²ⁿt⁾

**Solution:**

Amount after 1 year = Rs.1,000(1 + 0.20/2)⁽²×¹⁾ = Rs.1,210

Compound interest = Amount - Principal = Rs.1,210 - Rs.1,000 = Rs.210

**Therefore, the compound interest is Rs.210.**
